description: This file defines Flutter widgets related to displaying the progress of an order in an e-commerce app. It includes visual components such as dots and lines to represent different order statuses, and handles various statuses like 'Ordered', 'Processing', 'Packed', 'Shipped', 'Delivered', and 'Canceled'.

classes.name: OrderProgress
classes.description: A widget that visually depicts the progress of an order through various stages, using dots and connecting lines.

classes.name: ProcessDotWithLine
classes.description: A widget that renders a status indicator with connecting lines, used within the order progress widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for OrderProgress and ProcessDotWithLine widgets.

methods.name: statusWidget
methods.description: Returns a widget that visually represents a specific order status with icons or indicators based on the status.

methods.name: lineColor
methods.description: Determines the color of connecting lines based on the order status.
